clips.title: The story
paras: Craftsmen's Terrace gathers Darnassus's trades along the city's northern edge. Its workshops, trainers, inn, and Argent Dawn embassy draw artisans and visitors alike.

Woodworkers, leathercrafters, alchemists, and other artisans work along the northern edge of Darnassus. Their shops bring together many of the trades that keep the city running, using night elven methods for practical crafts. You can also find an inn, a guild master, and guild petition vendors here. Bridges lead west to the Cenarion Enclave and south to the Warrior's Terrace.

The Argent Dawn keeps an embassy in the Craftsmen's Terrace, coordinating with northern allies against the Scourge. The district's workshops also hold scattered scholarly volumes. Among them are histories of the War of the Ancients, chronicles of the Second War, and treatises on the Old Gods.
